Friday, September 18.description:
Dear Silver Wolves,
On September 18 at 9am we have arranged for a tour of the Debra March manufacturing center of excellence. This is a great new center of training for careers in manufacturing. This has been created in conjunction with the College of Southern Nevada, Clark County School District, and also manufacturing companies like Haas. They have all the latest technology and it’s very impressive. 

Key details:

Sept 18, 9am
2200 Via Inspirada
(right by the new police station , ie south of Raiders Way)

Only 15 spots are available !!

*******You must RSVP to Rich Blotner at rblotner7@gmail.com and he will confirm your spot or tell you if you are on a wait list******
